title: 2020 AMC 8 Problem 17
statement: How many factors of \(2020\) have more than \(3\) factors? (As an example, \(12\) has \(6\) factors, namely \(1,\) \(2,\) \(3,\) \(4,\) \(6,\) and \(12.\))

solutions.text:
Since \(2020=2^2\cdot5\cdot101,\) it has \[ (2+1)(1+1)(1+1)=12 \] positive factors.

Among those factors, only \(1\) and the primes \(2,\) \(5,\) and \(101\) have fewer than three factors, while \(4\) has exactly three. The other \(12-5=7\) factors therefore have more than three factors.

Thus, the correct answer is B.
hints: List or factor the divisors of \(2020\)
